description: Posts a visible suggestion to human collaborators watching the document WITHOUT making any changes to the diagram. Use this when you observe something worth flagging — a potential mistake, an improvement, or a question — but want the human to decide. The suggestion appears as a bold "SUGGESTION:" callout in the UI with a radar pulse animation on your presence dot for 10 seconds. Does NOT mutate the diagram. Requires a valid viewer or editor access token.

agentId.description: YOUR AI assistant name (e.g. "Claude.ai", "GitHub Copilot"). Shown as "[agentId] working with [userName]" in the collaboration presence dot.

entityId.description: ID of the node or container this suggestion relates to. Always provide this when the suggestion concerns a specific element — it moves the AI cursor to that element so collaborators know exactly what you are referring to.

suggestion.description: The suggestion text to show to human collaborators (max 500 chars). Be concise and actionable.

token.description: Viewer or editor access token for this document.

userName.description: First name of the human you are assisting.

name: make_suggestion
